descripcion: Travel guides, practical advice and authentic experiences from the Peruvian Andes. Everything you need to know before your journey.

tours.title: Super Sacred Valley Tour
tours.description: Explore Chinchero, Moray, the Maras Salt Mines, Ollantaytambo and Pisac on a full-day cultural experience.

tours.title: Pallay Punchu Mountain Tour
tours.description: Discover one of Cusco's most impressive geological formations, with colorful stripes and sharp peaks resembling a traditional Andean poncho.

tours.title: Mystical Cusco Tour
tours.description: Discover the Abode of the Gods, Goblin Valley, Huasao Wetland and Ents Park on an alternative cultural route.

tours.title: Cusco City Tour
tours.description: Explore the treasures of the Inca Empire: Qorikancha, Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Puka Pukara and Tambomachay.

tours.title: Rainbow Mountain
tours.description: Discover Vinicunca, its natural colors and impressive views of Ausangate on a full-day adventure from Cusco.

tours.title: Humantay Lake
tours.description: Discover its turquoise waters and dramatic snowcapped peaks on a full-day adventure from Cusco.

tours.title: Q’eswachaka Inca Bridge
tours.description: Discover the last handwoven Inca bridge and the living culture of Canas communities on a full-day trip from Cusco.

tours.title: Waqrapukara
tours.description: Discover the horned fortress, its archaeological landscapes and views over Apurímac Canyon.

tours.title: Cusco Express
tours.description: Escape to Cusco and Machu Picchu to discover Inca history, the magic of the Andes and Peru's cultural essence.

tours.title: Imperial Cusco
tours.description: Experience Cusco, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain in five days.
